questions.question: Pause must preserve?
options: Regs+pc/sp/flags, state, id/parent, files, space root
questions.explanation: Resume needs the full drawer set, not an ID.

questions.question: Trapframe vs PCB?
options: Trapframe = user CPU state at trap; PCB = card holding it + identity/resources

questions.question: Clobber-then-restore proves?
options: Snapshot carries resume (not luck): trash-then-copy-back exact
questions.explanation: Delete the snapshot and it fails: the copy is load-bearing.

questions.question: 0x202 flags means?
options: IF set: interrupts were enabled (restored on resume)
questions.explanation: Flags ride along: resume restores interrupt posture too.

questions.question: fork at field level?
options: New pid, copied frame+rows, shared-then-COW space
questions.explanation: Photocopy row, renumber, share space lazily.

questions.question: Two PCBs cross-talk?
questions.explanation: Rows independent by construction; test pins it.
